title: 璐璐·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 紫色小约德尔人戴高弯尖帽，带翅膀的皮克斯与其相伴。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Lulu is a small adult yordle enchantress with softly purple skin, large green eyes, purple hair, an exceptionally tall curved pointed hat, and a compact species-specific body. Preserve her adult yordle age without turning her into a human child or enlarging infant features. A fully covering long-sleeved tunic dress, opaque leggings, and boots complete her outfit, while her staff stays grounded and Pix remains a separate winged companion.
art_direction.scene: A balanced near-frontal full character, subtle contrapposto if anatomically appropriate, silhouette opening into a large quiet paper field. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: violet, sage green, pale gold, warm lavender; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
